stackCorrection: Brief assumed Vue 3 + Mongoose. Actual stack: NestJS 11 + Next.js 15/React 19 + Prisma 6 / PostgreSQL 16. All phases re-mapped.

findings.title: CLAUDE.md documents a @nestjs/config/ConfigService setup that does not exist
findings.summary: @nestjs/config is not a dependency; config is a memoised config() singleton parsing process.env via Zod. ConfigModule provides nothing.

findings.title: JWT_REFRESH_SECRET required at startup but never used
findings.summary: Refresh tokens are opaque sessionId.secret strings hashed with SHA-256 into RefreshSession.tokenHash. No signing key participates. Rotating the secret invalidates nothing, misleading incident response.

findings.title: Concurrency and money test suites mock Prisma, so DB-level guarantees are never exercised
findings.summary: 174 passing unit tests with a mocked client cannot demonstrate that unique constraints, transaction isolation, or updateMany guards hold under real concurrent writes.

findings.title: Frontend response types hand-copied from backend DTOs; two rival pagination envelopes
findings.summary: packages/contracts is 43 lines with 4 importers. PublicTeacher etc. are standalone types duplicating ~25 Prisma Teacher fields with no drift detection. Paginated<T> and ItemsPage<T> coexist.

findings.title: schema.prisma.bak committed beside the live schema
findings.summary: Stale duplicate schema will drift from the real one and mislead readers.

findings.title: Kavenegar URL construction duplicated across 3 call sites
findings.summary: Same template-API URL built by hand in sms.service.ts:7, queue.service.ts:65 and support.service.ts:194 instead of one shared client, so timeout/retry/error policy cannot be applied in one place.

findings.title: Backend source committed minified (lines up to 2172 chars)
findings.summary: Hand-written source in src/ with entire services on one line defeats line-level review, git blame, and stack-trace-to-line mapping.

findings.title: Expiry job enqueued after commit with no outbox or sweeper; orphaned PENDING_PAYMENT bookings block slots permanently
findings.summary: queue.add runs after COMMIT. If the process dies in that window the booking-expiration job never exists, expireBooking only runs from that job, the reconciliation cron covers payments only, and assertSlotAvailable counts PENDING_PAYMENT as occupying the slot.

findings.title: No timeout on any of the 5 outbound provider calls
findings.summary: Bare fetch() with no AbortSignal at all 5 provider call sites. Node fetch has no default timeout, so a hung Zarinpal stalls payment callbacks and 5 hung Kavenegar calls stall all reminder delivery (worker concurrency 5).

findings.title: SearchService owns no tables yet reads payment and booking directly
findings.summary: Touches booking, payment, user, teacher, language, testDefinition, passage. A read-model component with direct access to the payments table; Payment changes must be regression-tested against a module nobody would check.

findings.title: Notification written from 5 domains with no owning service; booking notifications skip idempotency, delivery rows and preferences
findings.summary: queue.service.ts:58 sets idempotencyKey and creates a NotificationDelivery; bookings.service.ts:267/319/351/397 set neither and never consult NotificationPreference, so a user who disabled a type still receives it.

findings.title: AdminService is a 14-model god object reaching tables instead of owning services
findings.summary: Writes userRole, rolePermission, setting, cmsPage and reads payment, walletEntry, payoutBatch, booking, testAttempt, ticket, teacher across 9 domains, bypassing invariants enforced in those domains' services.

findings.title: OtpChallenge and RefreshSession grow without bound
findings.summary: No delete path anywhere in apps/api/src, no TTL, expiresAt unindexed. RefreshSession gains ~1 row per 15-min token rotation per active user.

findings.title: User.email neither unique nor indexed while phone is unique
findings.summary: Two accounts may hold the same email.

findings.title: OtpChallenge.userId has no onDelete rule while RefreshSession cascades
findings.summary: Inconsistent deletion semantics; orphaned challenges survive user deletion.

findings.title: RefreshSession.replacedById models the rotation chain as an unconstrained string
findings.summary: A dangling id is undetectable.

findings.title: Favorite.teacherId has no foreign key or relation
findings.summary: userId has @relation at :399, teacherId has none. Favorites can point at deleted teachers and are never cascaded.

findings.title: NotificationPreference is never consulted by notification/SMS send paths
findings.summary: queue.service.ts:58,65 and bookings.service.ts:267 create notifications and send SMS without reading preferences; disabling a channel has no effect.

findings.title: User.avatarKey is a loose S3 key with no FK to StoredFile
findings.summary: Avatar objects sit outside the tracked file lifecycle.

findings.title: User.locale and User.timezone are unconstrained strings
findings.summary: DB accepts any value despite localeSchema existing in contracts.

findings.title: Teacher languages stored twice with no synchronising constraint
findings.summary: Teacher.languages String[] duplicates the TeacherLanguage join table; both are exposed in the API contract (apps/web/src/lib/api.ts:46).

findings.title: VerificationItem has no index on teacherId, its only query key
VerificationHistory has no index and a loose actorId, unlike sibling TeacherPriceHistory
Six price columns plus two legacy trialPrice/regularPrice columns model two prices
findings.summary: The legacy pair holds unapproved values; bookings.service.ts:90 must use approved* only.

findings.title: Teacher.introVideoKey is a loose S3 key with no FK
Review visibility modelled by two independent columns with no linking constraint
findings.summary: (REJECTED, published=true) is representable.

findings.title: Teacher replies are a column pair, capping replies at one with no moderation state
Review.rating has no CHECK constraint yet feeds the denormalized Teacher.rating average
Review.studentId is unindexed
AvailabilityOverride declares @@unique and @@index on identical columns
findings.summary: The unique constraint already creates the B-tree; the index is pure duplicate write cost.

findings.title: One override per teacher per date makes split availability on a date unrepresentable
AvailabilityOverride.adminOverride is declared and defaulted but never written
findings.summary: The admin path writes BlockedPeriod.adminCreated instead.

findings.title: CancellationPolicy.rules is untyped Json and approvedById is a loose string
findings.summary: Correctness rests entirely on the defensive refundTiers parser at bookings.service.ts:25-35.

findings.title: Blocked-period overlap check is read-then-write with no transaction or exclusion constraint
Booking.type is a free String with two real values while sibling status is an enum
findings.summary: Compared as string literals at bookings.service.ts:73,74,90,155,159,180.

findings.title: ClassRecord.completedAt duplicates Booking.status=COMPLETED
findings.summary: Only notes justifies the satellite table.

findings.title: Reminder.status/type are free strings; scheduledAt/status unindexed; rows never pruned
Booking.paymentExpiresAt and status are unindexed
findings.summary: The sweep that would repair F-101 has no index to use.

findings.title: BookingStatus.REFUNDED appears unwritten
findings.summary: cancel() sets CANCELLED and moves only the payment to REFUNDED.

findings.title: Payment.referenceId is polymorphic with no FK and no constraint tying it to purpose
findings.summary: Booking id or package id; dangling and mismatched references are representable.

findings.title: WalletEntry.referenceType/referenceId are polymorphic with no FK and no index
findings.summary: The ledger cannot be joined back to its source rows by the database.

findings.title: Refund.gatewayReference declared but never written; status always 'completed'
findings.summary: Schema-level evidence that no refund path reaches the gateway (refunds.service.ts:23, payments.service.ts:293, bookings.service.ts:219).

findings.title: Payment.userId, Refund.paymentId, Reconciliation.paymentId, WalletEntry.account all unindexed
Five money columns carry two arithmetic invariants with no CHECK constraint
findings.summary: Invariants exist only in createPaymentRecord (payments.service.ts:104,112).

findings.title: Payment.purpose, Refund.status, Discount.type are free strings where enums are used elsewhere
Package.approvalStatus reuses ReviewStatus, making NEEDS_REVISION meaningless
Enrollment.expiresAt never written; CreditEntryType.EXPIRE/ADJUST have no writer
findings.summary: Package credits never expire despite the schema modelling expiry; payments.service.ts:272 omits expiresAt.

findings.title: Two ledgers use opposite sign conventions
findings.summary: CreditEntry.amount is signed; WalletEntry.amount is positive-with-direction.

findings.title: Package.teacherId, Enrollment.studentId and Enrollment.packageId unindexed
findings.summary: Only query keys, including on the public GET /packages/teacher/:teacherId.

findings.title: Enrollment.paymentId and PackageRecommendation.teacherId/studentId are loose strings
Earning.status and eligibleAt unindexed; every payout generation scans the earnings table
Two payout paths share no schema-level constraint
findings.summary: WithdrawalRequest records an amount with no link to the Earning rows it settles, while PayoutItem.earningId is unique.

findings.title: PayoutBatch.totalAmount is a stored denormalized sum with no schema-level recomputation guarantee
PayoutItem.teacherId, PayoutBatch.approvedById, WithdrawalRequest.reviewedById are loose strings
Earning.netAmount stores gross minus commission with no CHECK
WithdrawalRequest.iban stores a bank account number in plaintext
findings.summary: Carried to Phase 7.

findings.title: TestDefinition.version exists but no @@unique([slug,version])
findings.summary: Editing a published test mutates it in place, changing the meaning of already-scored attempts.

findings.title: Passage lacks the @@unique([sectionId,order]) that TestSection and Question both have
TestScore.aiBand has no writer in any service touching testScore
findings.summary: Likely dead; confirm in Phase 4.

findings.title: Review state duplicated across TestAnswer and ExaminerReview with no consistency constraint
findings.summary: reviewStatus/finalScore/feedbackFa,En/reviewCriteria vs status/band/feedbackFa,En/criteria.

findings.title: Five FK-shaped columns in the assessment domain are loose strings
findings.summary: Question.passageId, TestAttempt.currentSectionId, AttemptSectionState.sectionId, ExaminerReview.examinerId, TestScore.approvedById.

findings.title: TestAttempt.status unindexed; no constraint prevents concurrent IN_PROGRESS attempts per (userId,testId)
MatchingSession.availability Json overlaps suitableDays and preferredTime and has no counterpart in the Zod contract
MatchingSession.userId unindexed although GET /matching/history filters on it; the one index that exists serves no endpoint
MatchingRecommendation.teacherId unindexed; several fields constrained in Zod only
Column maxTrialPrice is populated from a contract field named budget
LearningPlan has no indexes at all despite GET /learning/plans filtering by studentId or teacherId
findings.summary: Milestone.planId and Assignment.planId also unindexed despite cascade deletes.

findings.title: Assignment.submission is bare unbounded text with no StoredFile link
findings.summary: Unlike TestAnswer.fileId; submissions sit outside the tracked file lifecycle.

findings.title: TrialEvaluation.teacherId/studentId/recommendedPackageId are denormalized copies with no FK
findings.summary: Sibling bookingId is a proper FK.

findings.title: LearningPlan.status and Assignment.status are free strings; Milestone lacks @@unique([planId,order])
Ticket.slaDueAt written but unindexed and no job acts on it
findings.summary: The SLA is recorded, not enforced; the only cron is reconciliation.

findings.title: Internal staff notes share TicketReply with user-visible replies, flagged two independent ways
findings.summary: internal Boolean and messageType=INTERNAL_NOTE; filtering one but not the other leaks staff notes.

findings.title: Notification stores pre-rendered titleFa/En and bodyFa/En per row
findings.summary: 4 duplicated strings per row, frozen at send time, while LocalizedContent exists in the same schema for this purpose.

findings.title: Notification.readAt unindexed despite the unread badge querying it on every page load; NotificationDelivery has no indexes at all
TicketReply.attachmentId is a loose string with no FK to StoredFile
Ticket.category and priority are free strings in a model defining three enums
StoredFile.ownerId is unindexed with no FK though every access check filters on it
checksum is client-declared and never recomputed from uploaded bytes; no content/AV scanning
findings.summary: status=SAFE, which download() gates on at :119, asserts only size/type consistency.

findings.title: Two addressing schemes for one store: fileId FKs vs raw S3 keys
checksum unindexed and non-unique so it cannot dedupe; purpose is a free string used as a key path segment
Three-step upload with no reclamation of abandoned PENDING rows or S3 objects
findings.summary: status=DELETED has no deletedAt or lifecycle link.

findings.title: Schema defaults languageId='lang-en' depend on a literal id forced by the seed
findings.summary: Works as seeded (prisma/seed.ts:88) but breaks if English is recreated with a generated cuid().

findings.title: LocalizedContent is fully designed and indexed but read and written by nothing
findings.summary: Every model still uses paired fa/en columns.

findings.title: TeacherLanguage is duplicated by Teacher.languages and Teacher.specialties arrays
@@index([entityType,entityId]) is a redundant prefix of the @@unique on LocalizedContent
Deleting a Language cascades away all TeacherLanguage rows while TestDefinition/MatchingSession block the delete
findings.summary: Inconsistent and destructive.

findings.title: AuditLog.before/after store full row snapshots with no redaction and no retention
findings.summary: Inherits PII: phone, iban, ticket bodies.

findings.title: Setting.value is untyped Json driving the booking window
findings.summary: Correctness rests on SettingsService.numeric default+ceiling clamping.

findings.title: Setting.public is a single boolean gating the unauthenticated GET /support/public-settings
CmsPage has updatedAt but no createdAt
AuditLog.actorId nullable with no way to distinguish system action from unrecorded actor
